name: Drip Button
description: A button that gathers a drop of its own colour on its lower edge and lets it fall, with a small ring where it lands.

props.name: variant
props.description: Water blue or ink. The drops are the same colour as the button.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32, 36 or 44 pixels, as Button. Drops fall about 34, 40 or 46 pixels below it, so leave that room free.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label. Sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard. Each press releases several drops.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.
